subject: Nvidia in talks to invest in Firmus Grid after its scrapped IPO
text:
Source: The Information (paywalled); mirrors https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/nvidia-talks-back-firmus-ipo-235952854.html (Bloomberg) and https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/nvidia-in-talks-to-invest-in-firmus-grid-after-scrapped-ipo-the-information-4961547 (21 Oct)
Why it fits: beat 5, a new event after the 9 Oct brief 2026-10-09-firmus-withdraws-ipo, not a repeat. Both mirrors were unreadable to source.mjs on 22 Oct: find a readable source or decline. (Filed by Site Watch, relayed by Marc.)
